description: Checks a shortcut map. Pass `shortcuts`, one per line in the form `Cmd+K: Open search` (Mod, Cmd, Ctrl, Alt, Option, Shift and symbols like the command key are understood), and optionally `platform`: any (default), mac or windows. Flags duplicates within your list, collisions with common browser, text-editing and OS shortcuts, Ctrl+Alt combinations that equal AltGr on Windows or the VoiceOver modifier on Mac, screen reader keys, and single-character shortcuts under WCAG 2.1.4 Character Key Shortcuts (turn off, remap, or active only on focus). The built-in table is a convention-level summary of defaults, not exhaustive. No rendering, nothing stored.

platform.description: Platform to judge against. Default any.

shortcuts.description: One shortcut per line, such as `Cmd+K: Open search`.

name: check_keyboard_shortcuts
title: Keyboard shortcut conflicts
